title: Message Action Accessibility QA
principle: Transcript controls must work for keyboard and assistive technology users, not only pointer users.
public_repo_rule: Accessibility evidence is selector and copy metadata only. It contains no prompts, responses, tokens, provider keys, pairing codes, billing data or private telemetry.

checks.expected: Action buttons are grouped with a concise accessible label.
Each transcript action keeps a specific aria-label.
evidence: Copy a redacted safe share for this answer

checks.expected: Action feedback is connected to the group and announced politely.
Keyboard focus has a visible outline and stable button sizing.
